# UI Design Editor

Source: https://uidesigneditor.com/

## 100% local editor

- All files stay in your browser

- No signup

- Free to use

- [Open source on GitHub](https://github.com/janpmz/uidesigneditor)

---

# About

Move and resize text, shapes, icons and pictures in your browser.

Your work stays in this browser. The editor sends no project data to a server.

Use **Copy HTML** to keep a file. Clearing browser data removes saved drafts.

Free to use. [View the code on GitHub](https://github.com/janpmz/uidesigneditor).

[Open editor](https://uidesigneditor.com/)
